decision.reasoning_trace: I filtered out the several items in the feed that were merely accessories (cases, covers, and adapters). From the remaining actual speakers, I selected five that had strong ratings and high review counts. The DOSS (prod_008) and EDUPLINK (prod_051) stood out for their performance specs. I ultimately chose the EDUPLINK speaker because it offers a highly competitive price point ($27.74) while maintaining a 4.5 rating across over 9,000 reviews, indicating high reliability and customer satisfaction for a waterproof portable unit.
